capabilities.name: COGO points, Delaunay TIN surface, and cut/fill volumes
capabilities.reference_behavior: 3D COGO points form Delaunay TIN surface. Evaluates barycentric elevation interpolation and computes prismoidal cut/fill earthwork volumes against a datum elevation.
capabilities.expected_input: 3 survey points forming triangle, datum elevation 8.0 m
capabilities.expected_output: Interpolated elevation 10.0 m; cut volume 100 m3, fill volume 0 m3
capabilities.differences: Breaklines and boundary clipping are planned for subsequent iterations.

capabilities.name: Horizontal alignment, station equations, and station/offset projection
capabilities.reference_behavior: Parametric tangent/curve alignment calculates cumulative engineering stationing (STA 00+00.00) and projects (x, y) coordinates to station and perpendicular signed offset.
capabilities.differences: Clothoid spiral transition curves are deferred.

capabilities.name: Vertical profile PVI grade calculation and LandXML 1.2 interoperability
capabilities.reference_behavior: Profile PVI station/elevation evaluation along alignment and LandXML 1.2 standard export with CgPoints, Surfaces, and Alignments.
capabilities.expected_output: Elevation 120.0 m at STA 400; valid LandXML 1.2 XML document
capabilities.differences: Subassemblies and corridor surface generation are planned for a subsequent iteration.
